title: Michamvi: Sunsets on the East Coast
excerpt: On the Michamvi peninsula, on Zanzibar's east coast, you can watch the sun set over the bay. Quiet beaches and calm water.
body:
Michamvi is a peninsula on the east coast of Zanzibar. Because of its shape, the western side faces Chwaka Bay, which means you can watch the sun set over the water, unusual for the east coast.

## Why Michamvi

- Sunsets over the bay.
- Quiet beaches.
- Calm water on the bay side.
- Close to the famous restaurant on a rock in the sea near Pingwe.

## Tides

On the ocean side, tidal differences are large, as elsewhere on the east coast.

## Who it suits

Couples, travellers who want peace, and people who want both sunrise and sunset in one place.

## Combine

With [Paje](/blog/kitesurfing-paje/) or [Jozani](/blog/jozani-forest-red-colobus/).

[Plan your stay in Michamvi](/travel-proposal/).
